description: labels.define pruning (LabelPruner.delete_labels): one paged read of the live definitions, then DELETE /labels/{name} (204 No Content with NO body, a known success; the name percent-encoded, a space included) for the owned label the repository holds. A name the repository does not hold ('bh:absent') sends nothing; the human label 'bug' is untouched. Used by tests/test_tracker_github_label_definitions.py.

Shapes follow the documented GitHub REST 'Labels' endpoints, API version 2022-11-28 (List labels for a repository, Create a label, Update a label, Delete a label).
